title: HARDKORE
wikitext:
'''Hardkore''' is an American Quaker that is the heavy weapions guy of Clan Prozac. == History == He started playing Quake on Mplayer in 1998. In 1999 he left Mplayer and went on to Gamespy 3d. In 2000 He started playing on the server belonging to [[Clan Prozac]]. In 2002 He was granted entry into [[Clan Prozac]] be Snake [cp] who he considers his partner in crime when it comes to killing the monsters on the Co-op server. In 2003 he left the game to help support his family in there time of need. Around the time of thanksgivin of 2006 he got Quake put on a new computer and made his return to the game on a server that had one other player, Snake [cp]. Now Hardkore runs the [http://www.angelfire.com/crazy/clanprozac/ Clan Prozac Website] In early 2008, fate came intervened. he finally let someone into his cold heart and did not want to be a bad guy anymore. He became the ultimate good guy. He is now Captain America. Everybody’s hero. Its 2009. He is maper now. The custom tf coop plays his maps. One out of ever four that is played is made by him. If you see him online. He will have his warlocks knife or playing d keeping the flag safe. == Other reincarnations of Hardkore ==
